requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

803-1486-4231-5361--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Arcane Adaptation, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Auton Soldier. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Arcane Adaptation, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

569-1418-2226.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
569-1418-2226.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Mist Raven by paying its mana cost.
When Mist Raven enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

3967-5254-6774.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
3967-5254-6774.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, Repeat.

222-527-3480-3899.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3480-3899.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1339-4063-4247-6625.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

2111-4981-5330.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

413-443-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
413-443-2946-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Magus of the Bridge and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cult Conscript enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

6006-7296-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
6006-7296-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
6006-7296-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-2734-3899-4552-7704.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Cyberdrive Awakener
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more counters on it

2092-4050-5523-7218.description:
Activate Reaping Willow by paying {W/B} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and removing two counters from it, returning Defiant Greatmaw from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Defiant Greatmaw enters, it triggers, putting two -1/-1 counters on Reaping Willow.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Defiant Greatmaw, adding {W/B}.
Repeat.

254-2511--5.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2

232-1235-5026-7487.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Zealous Lorecaster.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Zealous Lorecaster with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Zealous Lorecaster tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Reverberate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1061-3557-7393.easyPrerequisites: You control a Shard that doesn't have summoning sickness.
1061-3557-7393.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
An opponent cannot block Brago.
1061-3557-7393.description:
Activate Niko by paying {2} and tapping it, exiling Timestream Navigator and causing Shards you control to become a copy of Timestream Navigator until the end step.
Activate a Shard by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage using Brago. It triggers, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
At the beginning of the next end step, Timestream Navigator is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

1824-2530-2932-6556.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-2932-6556.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-4772-7329.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Mind Transfer Protocol
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.
Animate Spawning Pit using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

546-4499-4613-7236.easyPrerequisites: The total toughness of creatures you control excluding Towering Titan is at least 5.
546-4499-4613-7236.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Towering Titan. Towering Titan enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Towering Titan using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

969-3259-7208.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-3259-7208.description:
Declare Pestered Wellguard and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers. Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Faerie token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

4038-5840-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Nantuko Elder's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.

2366-3430-4927-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3430-4927-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

3054-3416-4506-5670.easyPrerequisites: You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
3054-3416-4506-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire and Oathsworn Vampire enter, Auriok Champion triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader twice by paying 2 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire and the Vampire token, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

4872-6122-6927.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Damage Control Crew by paying its mana cost.
When Damage Control Crew enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Damage Control Crew from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

5078-5243-6747.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

4908-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1170-2834-3940-6586.description:
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {3}{R}.
Displacer Kitten, Vivi and Haze of Rage's storm ability trigger.
Resolve the Vivi trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Holding priority, activate Vivi by paying {0}, adding at least {3}{R}.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Vivi.
When Vivi enters the battlefield, Hero's Blade triggers, attaching Hero's Blade to Vivi.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, copying it for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve all Haze of Rages, returning the original Haze of Rage to your hand.
Repeat.

1445-4508-6428.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4508-6428.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Magmakin Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2533-2719-4681-5256.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Repeat.

2608-3443-4499.notablePrerequisites: Deathbloom Ritualist does not have summoning sickness. You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
2608-3443-4499.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat.

requires.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it
with a takeover counter on it

2438-5326--5--6.notablePrerequisites:
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of either the persist or undying creature.
The Master does not have a +1/+1 counter on it if it is a copy of the undying creature, or a -1/-1 counter on it otherwise.
2438-5326--5--6.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing The Master.
When The Master dies, if it was a copy of the undying creature, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of the persist creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Otherwise, if The Master was a copy of the persist creature, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of the undying creature with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

851-1558-2740-4231.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Tamiyo's Journal triggers, creating two Food, two Clue, and two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

618-1558-3263-3866.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Abhorrent Overlord with haste.
When the Abhorrent Overlord token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Harpy creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Abhorrent Overlord token and the Harpy tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1580-3602-4050-4929.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and goading it.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

1350-1812-2713-4617.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin twice by paying {2}, giving any two creatures trample until end of turn.
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {1}, giving any creature trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {W}, returning Soulbright Flamekin from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Soulbright Flamekin by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.

91-3944-4968-5112.notablePrerequisites: Mairsil does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
91-3944-4968-5112.description:
Activate Mairsil using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, giving Mairsil undying until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Pet's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Mairsil dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Mairsil using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

208-1017-1242-1656.notablePrerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
208-1017-1242-1656.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Thought Courier's ability by tapping it, causing you to loot.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Necrotic Ooze.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using CInderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

3327-4871-5147.notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast Dargo for {R}.
3327-4871-5147.description:
Cast Dargo by paying {R}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to put Dargo into the command zone from your graveyard.
Dargo dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

334-3603-5195-5243.notablePrerequisites: The Reality Chip attached to any creature except Bloodwater Entity.
334-3603-5195-5243.description:
Cast Cloudshift either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {W}, targeting Bloodwater Entity.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Bloodwater Entity.
Bloodwater Entity enters the battlefield, putting Cloudshift on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1020-2906-3689-4050.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
1020-2906-3689-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding one mana of any color.
Workshop Assistant dies, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding one mana of any color.
Myr Retriever dies, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying at most {1}.
Repeat.

3741-4398.description:
Whenever a player casts an instant or sorcery spell, Eye of the Storm triggers, exiling that spell and allowing the player to copy each spell exiled by Eye of the Storm and cast them from exile.
When the player casts the copies made by Eye of the Storm, Void Mirror triggers, countering those copies.
